lighting_shading.note: Soft, even lighting with gentle highlights on the beak and comb.

value_contrast.note: Warm subject pops clearly against the cool blue background.

color_palette.note: Vibrant orange chicken contrasts strongly with the blue ocean.

composition_hierarchy.note: The diagonal wave leads the eye directly to the central character.

shape_proportions.note: Chunky, toy-like proportions with a very readable, simple silhouette.

viewpoint_depth.note: Clear separation between the foreground wave, character, and background.

edges_linework.note: Clean edges defined by color and shading rather than dark outlines.

surface_finish.note: Smooth, plastic-like finish typical of high-quality mobile game assets.

rhythm_staging.note: Active surfing pose with wings spread creates a sense of motion.

idea.recognition_cue: orange chicken on a yellow surfboard
